40/S0.subgoal: Identify the three main types of interaction in immersive environments.

40/S1.subgoal: Describe the basic components and goal of navigation in virtual environments.

40/S2.subgoal: List and briefly differentiate the four broad types of locomotion techniques.

40/S3.subgoal: Explain the three variations of walking-based locomotion: full gait, partial gait, and gait negation.

40/S4.subgoal: Describe steering-based locomotion using both body parts and dedicated physical hardware.

40/S5.subgoal: Distinguish between target selection-based and route planning-based locomotion techniques.

40/S6.subgoal: Understand how manipulation-based locomotion works using metaphors and gestures.

40/S7.subgoal: Define wayfinding and explain the components of a cognitive map.

40/S8.subgoal: Identify and describe methods for providing navigational support, such as landmarks and path following.

40/S9.subgoal: Describe the various methods used for controlling system state and modes in virtual environments.

40/S10.subgoal: Summarize the key design concepts and interaction techniques discussed in the lecture.
